subject: maths
question: 2 cubes each of volumes 125 cm³ are joined end to end. The surface area of the resulting cuboid is:
solution: **Given:** The volume of each cube = 125 cm³ **Formula used:** Volume of cube (V) = (side)³ Surface area of cuboid = 2 × (lb + bh + hl) Where, l = length ; b = breadth ; h = height **Calculation:** Volume of the cube (V) = 125 ⇒ (side)3 = 125
